Concept sheet of separate stylized 3D game nature assets for an autumn valley, in the hand-painted, soft, warm painterly style and daylight palette of the reference image (modern anime-inspired 3D RPG like AFK Journey, clean chunky stylized shapes, foliage as soft rounded clumps). Arrange them in one row with wide empty space between all objects, each one complete and fully visible, never overlapping, never cropped:
1) a slender birch tree with a white bark trunk with dark marks and a rounded clumpy canopy of golden-yellow autumn leaves;
2) a second birch tree, taller with two trunks and a canopy of mixed light green and yellow leaves;
3) a round leafy bush with soft green and amber clumps;
4) a large mossy grey boulder, rounded and chunky;
5) a flat cluster of two smaller grey stones with a little moss.
Each object seen from a three-quarter front view, camera slightly above (about 30 degrees). Plain flat light grey background, no ground, no grass base, no cast shadows, no scenery. Even soft lighting with almost no shading, flat hand-painted colors and soft painted textures, no black ink outlines, no text, no labels.
